Microsoft + OSM footprints. DuckDB + httpfs, not a custom building scraper. Suburbs are far more complete than OSM-only.
Cesium ion token, free tier. Region mesh for Unreal. Not photogrammetry.
1/3 arc-second DEM. Unreal Landscape or Cesium world terrain. Chicago is flat; still needed for river cuts and the lake bluff.
Use the JSON/SODA resource, not the empty GeoJSON export. Remap RS/B/M/POS → solarpunk dwell/make/grow in smartcity.twin.zoning.
City ArcGIS: streetlighting, parcels, centerlines. Zoning may sit in a separate Planning service — catalog the MapServer, do not scrape the website.
County parcels/zoning for the I-88 towns. Use FeatureServer queries with a bbox, not a county-wide dump on a laptop.
The regional land-use inventory. Better than stitching 200 municipal codes by hand.
Traffic Tracker historical speeds by region (bus GPS). Calibrates the diurnal, not a substitute for expressway probes.
10-minute arterial speed estimates on 1000+ segments from CTA bus GPS. Join on GERS/OSM later; do not treat 0 as a parking lot.
Current region congestion polygons + current_speed. 0 usually means no data, not a parking lot.
Vision Zero crashes. Weights danger scores on edges; solarpunk redesign should cut these, not hide them.
311 outages only. CDOT cites ~250k lights — the inventory is gated. Approximate poles from OSM highway length × spacing.
Actual pole points. Page with resultOffset; a single query hits the transfer limit.
Static schedules. Pair with GTFS-RT if the feed is up. Do not rewrite a transit router — use OpenTripPlanner or a GTFS library.
BNSF Naperville–Union Station is the suburb-core spine. One train is 800–1,600 highway seats.
Suburban bus. URL rotates; if 404, take the current zip from pacebus.com/gtfs.
IDOT Gateway. Kennedy REVLAC schedule is public. Live occupancy is HTML/GIS, not a clean API — parse or approximate.
Annual average daily traffic on state routes. Calibrates macro corridor vph.
Needs a User-Agent. Rain/snow raise TTI and cut solar. Do not invent a weather model.
LEHD LODES origin-destination. The honest commute matrix. Download IL + IN workplace/residence files, aggregate to districts.
County, place, tract polygons. Use these as district boundaries instead of drawing circles.
